metadata.name: Geochemical analysis of sediment core samples from Lake Chapala, Mexico
metadata.description: This dataset contains geochemical measurements from 41 sediment core samples collected at a single location in Lake Chapala, Jalisco, Mexico (21.28°N, 104.69°W) on April 8, 2022. The data includes 17 Centered Log-Ratio (CLR) transformed elemental concentrations (Si, K, Ca, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ge, Sr, Zr, Cd, Ce, Ta), sediment depth, age estimates, and an incoherent/coherent scattering ratio. The samples span a depth range of 0.0 to 0.2 meters and cover an age range from approximately 1867 to 2022 AD.
